text_blocks.snippet: A polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR) diet focuses on anti-inflammatory foods to manage symptoms and support overall health. It emphasizes whole foods, including fruits, vegetables, healthy fats, lean protein, and whole grains, while limiting processed foods, refined sugars, and unhealthy fats. Calcium and vitamin D are crucial for bone health, especially since corticosteroids, often used to treat PMR, can weaken bones.
